slots.ev: 店裡有客人在看架上的東西，她站在一旁沒有上前推銷

ppl.act: 在柚木層架前拿起東西看
ppl.wear: 雅加達南區逛選物店會穿的輕便衣服

slots.pl: 她在南雅加達那間很小的選物店裡，營業時間，白牆與柚木層架
slots.pl_en: inside her very small select shop in South Jakarta during opening hours, white walls and teak shelving
slots.ac: 她靠在櫃檯邊上，兩手都空著，把店留給客人自己看
slots.ac_en: She is leaning against the end of the counter with both hands free, leaving the customer to look on their own.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：招呼熟客，是她自己想做的事／語氣：平穩、有禮、不炫耀
slots.of: 白色亞麻長裙配同色系無袖上衣
slots.of_en: a white linen skirt with a matching sleeveless top
slots.li: 店門的自然光從側面進來，層架深處比較暗
slots.li_en: Daylight from the shop front comes in from the side, and it is darker back among the shelves.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「自然光為主、暖中性色調」
slots.fa: 很淡的表情，看著客人那一側
slots.fa_en: A very mild expression, watching in the customer's direction.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：淡淡的，常常自嘲自己的店很小
slots.hair_en: down and straight, tucked behind one ear

slots.ev: 打烊回公寓，落地窗沒有窗簾，外面的燈就是房間的燈
slots.pl: 她市中心公寓的落地窗前，整片窗上完全沒有窗簾
slots.pl_en: at the floor-to-ceiling window of her city-centre apartment, which has no curtains on it at all
slots.ac: 她一手撐在窗框上，身體側過去看外面
slots.ac_en: One hand rests against the window frame as she turns side-on to look out.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：公寓的落地窗從不裝窗簾
slots.of_en: a pale green silk slip dress on thin straps
slots.of_s: 私下核心：絲質吊帶裙／色盤：淡綠
slots.li: 外面的城市燈光在她身後，室內沒開燈，她的輪廓被窗光描出來
slots.li_en: The city lights are behind her and nothing indoors is switched on, so the window light draws her outline.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「雅加達的都會室內光為主…乾淨、溫暖、不喧鬧」
slots.fa: 剛洗完澡的鬆，沒有在看鏡頭
slots.fa_en: Loose and freshly showered, not looking at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 私下核心：剛洗完澡的長髮
slots.hair_en: long and damp, falling down her back

slots.ev: 新到的貨她一定自己先用一週，這週是這個
slots.pl: 她公寓的柚木矮櫃旁，新到的貨拆開放在櫃面上
slots.pl_en: beside the teak low cabinet in her apartment, this week's new stock unpacked across the top of it
slots.ac: 她坐在矮櫃旁的椅子上，把其中一件拿在手裡翻看
slots.ac_en: She is sitting in the chair beside the cabinet, turning one of the pieces over in her hand.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：新貨到一定自己先用一週
slots.of: 藤編米色的居家長洋裝
slots.li: 上午的窗光從左邊進來，柚木把光吃成暖色
slots.li_en: Morning window light comes in from the left, and the teak warms it as it lands.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「白牆、柚木、藤編、棕櫚陰影」
slots.fa_en: Focused, with no movement at the corners of her mouth.
slots.hair_en: pinned up loosely with a few strands escaping

slots.ev: 下午約在一間老房子改的咖啡店，棕櫚的影子打在牆上
slots.pl: 南雅加達一間老房子改的咖啡店，午後，棕櫚的影子落在白牆上
slots.pl_en: in a South Jakarta coffee shop converted from an old house in the afternoon, palm shadows falling across the white wall
slots.ac: 她兩手捧著杯子放在桌上，身體微微前傾
slots.ac_en: Both hands are around the cup on the table and she is leaning very slightly forward.
slots.of: 白色削肩上衣配淡綠色長褲
slots.of_en: a white off-shoulder top with pale green trousers
slots.li: 午後的自然光從窗那一側過來，棕櫚影子在牆上動
slots.li_en: Afternoon daylight comes from the window side, and the palm shadows shift on the wall behind her.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「棕櫚陰影。乾淨、溫暖、不喧鬧」
slots.fa: 很輕的笑，眼睛看著鏡頭
slots.fa_en: A very light smile, her eyes on the lens.

slots.ev: 晚上走回公寓，那條街上的店還開著
slots.pl: 南雅加達一條晚上還開著幾間店的街，剛下過雨，地是濕的
slots.pl_en: on a South Jakarta street where a few shops are still open at night, the ground wet from earlier rain
slots.ac: 她一個人慢慢走回去，手沒有拿東西
slots.ac_en: She is walking back slowly on her own with nothing in her hands.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：關門之後的公寓
slots.of: 暖石灰色的長版襯衫洋裝
slots.li: 店面招牌的光落在人行道上，街的另一側暗
slots.li_en: Light from the shopfront signs falls across the pavement, and the other side of the street stays dark.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「都會室內光為主…不喧鬧」——夜街用店面的光而不是路燈
